properties.name: weatherProvider
properties.title: Weather Provider
properties.description: Where the Weather pages, the Weather Overlay and the Weather Visualizer get the weather. Empty: the one that is set up (has its key), when there is only one.

properties.name: units
properties.title: Units
properties.description: The units the weather is shown in. Automatic: miles and Fahrenheit in the US time zones, kilometres and Celsius elsewhere. The two below change one kind of measurement only.

properties.name: maxStrikes
properties.title: Failures Before a Track Stops Running
properties.description: How many times in a row a playlist track may fail before it is struck out: it is not run again for a while and its slot shows its error page instead (a permanent problem, such as a missing setting, strikes it out at once).

properties.name: strikeRetrySeconds
properties.title: First Retry of a Struck-Out Track
properties.description: Seconds before a struck-out track is tried again (one attempt: it is struck out again if it fails, and a success puts it back in play). The wait doubles with each failed attempt, up to the longest wait below; changing the playlist tries it at once.

properties.name: strikeRetryMaxSeconds
properties.title: Longest Wait Between Retries
properties.description: The most seconds a struck-out track waits between attempts.
